method: Claude desktop built-in browser (Chromium), owner's computer; page origin https://example.com (no CSP); fetch() with default mode 'cors'; CORS failures read from the console ('No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header')
purpose: WP26 build-time check (spec §6): CORS behaviour, candle limits, ordering, open-bar flag, timeframe support of OKX, Coinbase Exchange and Upbit public market data

okx.cors: ALLOWED — every request (tickers SPOT/SWAP, public/instruments, market/candles, market/history-candles, market/books) returned 200 to a cross-origin page

candles.row: [ts, o, h, l, c, vol(base), volCcy, volCcyQuote, confirm] — confirm '0' = bar still open, '1' = closed
candles.paging: after=<ts> returns bars strictly older than ts
candles.bars_seen: 1H, 4H accepted; 8H rejected (code 51000 'Parameter bar error'); 1D is aligned to UTC+8 (16:00 UTC), 1Dutc is aligned to 00:00 UTC — use the *utc variants (6Hutc, 12Hutc, 1Dutc, 1Wutc, 1Mutc) for UTC bars

okx.tickers: /api/v5/market/tickers?instType=SPOT (1236 rows) or SWAP; fields instId,last,open24h,high24h,low24h,vol24h,volCcy24h,ts. SPOT volCcy24h is quote volume; SWAP volCcy24h is in base coin (BTC-USDT-SWAP 207733.5 BTC-equivalent ≈ vol24h 20773353.93 contracts × ctVal 0.01)
okx.swap_instrument: BTC-USDT-SWAP: ctType linear, ctVal 0.01, ctValCcy BTC, settleCcy USDT, state live

coinbase.cors: ALLOWED — /products, /products/volume-summary, /products/stats, /products/{id}/stats, /products/{id}/ticker, /products/{id}/candles all returned 200 cross-origin. The Advanced Trade public host https://api.coinbase.com/api/v3/brokerage/market/... was REFUSED (no CORS) and is not used

candles.limit_max: 300 per request with start/end (docs); without start/end 350 rows were returned
candles.row: [time(s), low, high, open, close, volume(base)] — note LOW before HIGH, then open, close
candles.gaps: no candle is published for an interval with no trades (docs)
candles.open_bar: the newest row may be the open bar — drop by close time

coinbase.products: 847 products; quotes USDT, USD, EUR, GBP, BTC, USDC, ETH, BRL, INR, AUD, DAI, SGD, CAD. BTC-USDC and ETH-USDC are status 'delisted', trading_disabled true (USDC books are served as USD) — use status 'online' and trading_disabled false only
coinbase.volume: /products/stats returns every product's stats_24hour {open, high, low, last, volume(base)} in one call (516 keys) — USD volume = volume × last

upbit.cors: UNRELIABLE — /v1/market/all and /v1/candles/minutes/240 sometimes returned 200 cross-origin; /v1/ticker, /v1/ticker/all, /v1/candles/days, /v1/candles/weeks and a repeat of /v1/market/all were refused ('No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header') in the same minute, including after 1.2 s spacing
upbit.fetch_path_chosen: rewrite-and-native, like Coins.ph (ADR-0013 pattern): web /x/upbit/... same-origin rewrite, native nativeGet() with a path-scoped allowlist, Node plain fetch

candles.row: {market, candle_date_time_utc, opening_price, high_price, low_price, trade_price (close), timestamp (last trade ms), candle_acc_trade_price (quote volume), candle_acc_trade_volume (base volume), unit}
candles.open_bar: the newest row is the open bar (its timestamp is the latest trade) — drop by close time

upbit.markets: /v1/market/all — 884 markets, quotes KRW, USDT, BTC; ids QUOTE-BASE (KRW-BTC, USDT-BTC, BTC-ETH); KRW-USDT exists (used to convert KRW volume to USD)
